assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Fails if a docs-only change ceases to resolve to review tier none or the repair row omits that tier; this establishes that the bypass input is exercised.
Fails if the tier-none promotion return is moved back before the open-finding check; node-repair-base.log observes exactly promotable-stale versus repair-owed.
Fails if a blocked docs-only row offers crew complete; the expected prohibition is independent of the produced command.
Fails if the stored unanswered finding cannot be read as wiring-1 before answering; a positive control on fixture setup, not credit for the production repair.
Fails if record_response does not persist an answer that unanswered_findings recognizes; reverting the fixture answer should fail this assertion but the later projection does not consume this store.

Compares read_pointer failure to the same pointer failure supplied to _write_json: this is a persistence receipt that can fail on lost or changed stored bytes, not an independent assertion that stale-refusal classification is repaired; no durability credit is assigned for that transition.
Fails if the projection of a queued classification emits a kind other than run-queued; the caller explicitly removed failure first, so this is not an end-to-end stale-refusal guard.
Fails if the current queue hold action ceases to name the lane; the fixture reason supplies lane allowance but the projection must actually emit it.
Fails if projection reintroduces wiring-1 into the action after classification has cleared failure; it will not fail merely because the upstream classifier retains stale refusals.
Fails if the held row uses a complete or review command, the foreign run ID, or any appended foreign action instead of exactly queue release for the independently known subject ID.
Fails if the real foreign run ID supplied in the adjacent live pointer and stale refusal appears in the held row action; the known-present foreign input makes this exclusion non-vacuous.
